title: Proxmox guests
description: Every VM and container, and one in depth: state, CPU, memory, balloon, pressure, disk and network.

list.name: bucket
list.label: Cluster
list.description: InfluxDB bucket: pve_cluster (the lylat cluster) or pve_greatfox (the standalone greatfox).

list.name: node
list.label: Node
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "${bucket}", tag: "host",
  predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "cpustat", start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)

list.name: guest
list.label: Guest
list.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r._field == "uptime" and r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["vmid"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.vmid + "|" + r.host + " (" + r.vmid + ")"}))
  |> distinct()
list.definition:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r._field == "uptime" and r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/)
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["vmid"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.vmid + "|" + r.host + " (" + r.vmid + ")"}))
  |> distinct()

panels.title: Guests
panels.description: Now (end of the time range). Memory is what the guest uses on the host (VM: memhost, CT: mem); Configured is its maximum. CPU is the share of its own vCPUs. Click a name for the guest's dashboard.

targets.query:
import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/ and
       (r._field == "cpu" or r._field == "cpus" or r._field == "mem" or r._field == "memhost" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "uptime" or r._field == "maxdisk"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({vmid: r.vmid, cpu: r.cpu, cpus: r.cpus, used: if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem,
       maxmem: r.maxmem, mempct: if r.maxmem > 0.0 then (if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem) / r.maxmem else 0.0,
       uptime: r.uptime, maxdisk: r.maxdisk}))

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/ and (r._field == "status" or r._field == "tags"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid", "host", "nodename", "object"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")

import "date"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: 3m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and (r.object == "qemu" or r.object == "lxc") and r.nodename =~ /^${node:regex}$/ and
       (r._field == "diskread" or r._field == "diskwrite" or r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout"))
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["vmid"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with netin: r.netin * 8.0, netout: r.netout * 8.0}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "status"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "uptime"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.object}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")

  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.nodename}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "uptime"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "cpus"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

panels.description: Configured memory.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "maxmem"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

panels.title: Disk size
panels.description: Size of the boot disk (CT: root filesystem).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "maxdisk"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "tags"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: strings.replaceAll(v: r._value, t: ";", u: " · ")}))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of the guest's vCPUs in use.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "cpu"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value}))

panels.title: Memory used
panels.description: Host memory the guest uses (VM: memhost, CT: mem) / configured memory. VMs with PCI passthrough pin all their memory, so they sit at 100%.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "mem" or r._field == "memhost" or r._field == "maxmem"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: (if exists r.memhost then r.memhost else r.mem) / r.maxmem}))

panels.title: Balloon
panels.description: VMs with the balloon driver: current balloon size / maximum. Below 100% means PVE took memory back from the guest.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ballooninfo" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "actual" or r._field == "max_mem"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.actual / r.max_mem}))

panels.title: Root disk (CT)
panels.description: Containers only: used / size of the root filesystem. PVE doesn't know how full a VM's disk is (always 0).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "disk" or r._field == "maxdisk") and r.object == "lxc")
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r.disk / r.maxdisk}))

panels.title: Pressure (avg10)
panels.description: Pressure stall information of the guest's cgroup: share of time some task waited for CPU, I/O or memory (10 s average).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "pressurecpusome" or r._field == "pressureiosome" or r._field == "pressurememorysome"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({cpu: r.pressurecpusome, io: r.pressureiosome, memory: r.pressurememorysome}))

panels.title: QEMU
panels.description: QEMU version and machine type the VM runs with (a VM keeps them until it restarts).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "running-qemu" or r._field == "running-machine"))
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> last(column: "_time")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({version: r["running-qemu"], machine: r["running-machine"]}))

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of the guest's vCPUs in use.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "cpu") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: "CPU"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: used: what the guest reports in use (VM: via the balloon driver, else the same as host); host: memory the VM process holds on the node; configured: the maximum; balloon target: what PVE asks the balloon to give back to; swap: CT swap.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "mem" or r._field == "memhost" or r._field == "maxmem" or r._field == "balloon" or r._field == "swap") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: (if r._field == "memhost" then "host" else if r._field == "mem" then "used" else if r._field == "maxmem" then "configured" else if r._field == "balloon" then "balloon target" else "swap")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Pressure
panels.description: Pressure stall information (10 s averages): some = at least one task waited, full = all tasks waited.

targets.query:
import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "pressurecpusome" or r._field == "pressurecpufull" or r._field == "pressureiosome" or r._field == "pressureiofull" or r._field == "pressurememorysome" or r._field == "pressurememoryfull") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: strings.trimPrefix(v: strings.replaceAll(v: strings.replaceAll(v: r._field, t: "some", u: " some"), t: "full", u: " full"), prefix: "pressure")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Disk throughput
panels.description: All disks of the guest; reads up, writes down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "diskread" or r._field == "diskwrite") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "diskread" then "read" else "write"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: IOPS per disk (VM)
panels.description: QEMU block statistics per virtual disk (VMs only).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "rd_operations" or r._field == "wr_operations") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + (if r._field == "rd_operations" then " read" else " write")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Latency per disk (VM)
panels.description: Average time per completed read and write, per virtual disk.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "rd_total_time_ns" or r._field == "rd_operations"))
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r.rd_operations > 0.0)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.rd_total_time_ns / r.rd_operations / 1000000000.0}))
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + " read"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "wr_total_time_ns" or r._field == "wr_operations"))
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r.wr_operations > 0.0)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r.wr_total_time_ns / r.wr_operations / 1000000000.0}))
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + " write"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "rd_bytes" or r._field == "wr_bytes") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + (if r._field == "rd_bytes" then " read" else " write")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Root disk used (CT)
panels.description: Containers only; PVE doesn't see inside a VM's disks.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "disk" or r._field == "maxdisk") and r.object == "lxc")
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "disk" then "used" else "size"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: I/O errors (VM)
panels.description: Failed and invalid operations per virtual disk since the VM started (should be 0).

targets.query:
import "date"
import "strings"
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
        |> range(start: date.sub(d: 2m, from: v.timeRangeStop), stop: v.timeRangeStop)
        |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "blockstat" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (strings.hasPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "failed_") or strings.hasPrefix(v: r._field, prefix: "invalid_")))
        |> last()
        |> group(columns: ["instance"])
        |> sum()
        |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> keep(columns: ["_value", "series"])

panels.title: Network
panels.description: All NICs of the guest; inbound up, outbound down.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "system" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "netin" then "in" else "out"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Per NIC (VM)
panels.description: Per tap interface (VMs only; container veths are on the node dashboard).

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nics" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "netin" or r._field == "netout") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value * 8.0}))
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: r.instance + (if r._field == "netin" then " in" else " out")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Balloon
panels.description: From the balloon driver: balloon size (memory the guest may use), maximum, and the guest's own view of total and free memory.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ballooninfo" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "actual" or r._field == "max_mem" or r._field == "total_mem" or r._field == "free_mem") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: (if r._field == "actual" then "balloon size" else if r._field == "max_mem" then "maximum" else if r._field == "total_mem" then "guest total" else "guest free")}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Page faults
panels.description: Per second, as the guest reports them. Major faults read from disk.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ballooninfo" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "major_page_faults" or r._field == "minor_page_faults") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "major_page_faults" then "major" else "minor"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])

panels.title: Guest swap
panels.description: Swapped in / out inside the guest.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
            |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
            |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ballooninfo" and r.vmid == "${guest}" and (r._field == "mem_swapped_in" or r._field == "mem_swapped_out") and true)
            |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1s, nonNegative: true)
            |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with series: if r._field == "mem_swapped_in" then "in" else "out"}))
|> group(columns: ["series"])
|> sort(columns: ["_time"])
|> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "series"])
